title: Bump quest to 0.12.0 for the lore/quest pair release (OPAG-761)
description:
Pair-release prep for lore/quest 0.12.0 (OPAG-761), dispatched by opum-agent. All three prerequisites have landed: opum-cli-e2e TASK-141 (across-refs rows) on its main at bf0fd2c, lore-cli LCLI-544 on its dev at 10274f64, and QCLI-419 (the build:candidate refusal) on quest-cli dev at 5f471205. lore and quest share one version and are released as a pair every time (constitution Article 3); 0.11.0 is already on npm for both, and across-refs is a new feature, so the shared version is 0.12.0. lore-cli bumps to the same number.

SCOPE IS THE BUMP ONLY. No publish, no RC staging, no tag, no promotion -- the orchestrator calls the release candidate once both packages are at 0.12.0 on dev, and publishing is this session's own dialog.

Follows the runbook section "What a version bump touches": strings first, then bytes, in separate commits, the shape used at 0.11.0 (eb1d9f46).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every hand-edited version site reads 0.12.0: package.json .version and its six optionalDependencies pins, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture questVersion, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and the six platform manifests; bun.lock's six pins are regenerated by bun install under the pinned bun. The site count is reported from a grep.

All six platform packages are rebuilt at 0.12.0 with the pinned bun 1.4.2 and committed, with each platform manifest's questBinarySha256 and root's questPlatformPackages regenerated; check:packages and check:lockfile exit 0.
CLAUDE.md's managed Quest block reads 0.12.0, regenerated by the freshly built darwin-arm64 binary rather than a stale global install, and quest agents --check reports current.
CHANGELOG.md's Unreleased notes are named 0.12.0 under a fresh empty Unreleased heading, and consumer-observable changes that landed since 0.11.0 with no entry are recorded (the QCLI-319 shape).
A source build prints 0.12.0 from --version, and the repository check suite exits 0 under the pinned bun.
The bump lands on dev by squash merge with every required check a completed success on the exact head SHA. Nothing is published, staged, tagged, or promoted.

plan: Sync every hand-edited version string to 0.12.0: root package.json .version and its six optionalDependencies pins, QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture's questVersion, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, and the six platform manifests. Then bun install under the pinned bun 1.4.2 to regenerate bun.lock's six pins.

Rebuild the six platform packages with bun 1.4.2 (build:packages), which regenerates each manifest's questBinarySha256 and root's questPlatformPackages, and regenerate CLAUDE.md's managed Quest block from the freshly built darwin-arm64 binary rather than the global install.
Name the 0.12.0 changelog section under a fresh empty Unreleased heading, recording the consumer-observable changes that landed since 0.11.0 with no entry (the QCLI-319 shape).
Run the repository check suite under the pinned bun, push the branch, open the PR into dev, wait for every required check to be a completed success on the exact head SHA, and squash-merge.

SITES: 24 version-string sites moved to 0.12.0 -- root package.json .version and its six optionalDependencies pins (7), the six platform manifests' version fields (6), QUEST_VERSION, QUEST_ADAPTER_PINNED_VERSION, the conformance fixture's questVersion, and .claude-plugin/plugin.json (4), bun.lock's six pins regenerated by bun install under 1.4.2 (6), and CLAUDE.md's managed Quest block (1). Twelve digest values were regenerated rather than substituted: each platform manifest's questBinarySha256 and root's questPlatformPackages map. A sweep for 0.11.0 outside .quest/ now returns only comments, usage examples, test-fixture literals and history (CHANGELOG.md, docs/log.md, the release runbook). The one live pin that deliberately stays is the lore gate's @opum-ai/lore@0.11.0: it moves by the QCLI-358 two-step -- re-export the schemas under the new lore, THEN move the pin -- and lore 0.12.0 is not published yet.

BYTES: build:packages cross-compiled all six targets with the pinned bun 1.4.2, regenerating each manifest's questBinarySha256 and root's questPlatformPackages in the same pass. This is the first release built with 1.4.2: QCLI-411 moved the pin and recorded that the committed npm/* binaries were still 1.3.14-built, and QCLI-419 makes this rebuild load-bearing rather than tidy -- on a release ref the candidate bundle refuses rebuilt platform artifacts, so the bytes committed here are the bytes that publish.

CHANGELOG: Unreleased became 0.12.0 under a fresh empty Unreleased heading, with no date (QCLI-398 dates a heading from the registry's time field once the version reaches npm). Nine changes that had landed since v0.11.0 with no entry were recorded -- QCLI-358, 377, 405, 407, 410, 411, 412, 415 and 417 -- the QCLI-319 shape.

VERIFIED: check:packages, check:lockfile, test:packages and check:breaking-bump all exit 0; bun run check exits 0 under the pinned bun 1.4.2 (1051 pass, 0 fail, 116 files); test:packages runs the packed launcher and asserts its --version against package.json, so the packed bytes are what reported 0.12.0; the freshly built npm/quest-darwin-arm64/bin/quest prints 0.12.0; bun src/cli/main.ts --version prints 0.12.0; quest agents --check --target claude reports state current.
